event: Interest subvention on short-term crop loans
detail: Budget 2006-07: 2 pp interest relief on crop loans up to Rs 1 lakh; later crop loans up to Rs 3 lakh at 7% p.a.

event: Agricultural Debt Waiver and Debt Relief Scheme (ADWDRS)
detail: Union Budget 2008-09; waiver of ~Rs 50,000 cr overdue loans + Rs 10,000 cr one-time settlement; RBI circular 23 May 2008, implementation by 30 June 2008; ~Rs 52,260 cr to 3.73 cr farmers

event: Additional interest subvention for prompt repayment

detail: NABARD revised KCC scheme; banks advised to issue KCC to all eligible farmers. KCC itself dates from 1998-99

event: Priority-sector lending revision: small & marginal farmer sub-target
detail: SMF sub-target 7% of ANBC for 2015-16 and 8% for 2016-17; direct lending to non-corporate farmers not below 3-yr system average

event: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) replaces NAIS/MNAIS
detail: Crop insurance linked to crop loans; 40.2 million farmers insured kharif 2016
